We need count of methyl groups in the molecule. But we don't have the molecule given. Possibly the sample is the compound at hand, which we can get NMR spectra to infer methyl groups. We could request proton NMR to see methyl signals (singlet ~0.9 ppm). But we need count of methyl groups (CH3). Could also use carbon NMR for methyl carbon ~10-30 ppm.

We need to decide which tool to use. Probably get proton NMR first. Use proton_nmr_spectra.
